02 / THE GOOD-DOG ITINERARY

A little adventure.
A lovely long nap.

The best kind of busy, with plenty of time to do absolutely nothing. Here’s how a day might unfold.

  1. 8:00 AM

    Wake up. Sniff the day.

    A gentle morning walk, fresh air, and breakfast just the way they know it.

  2. 10:00 AM

    Let the good times roll.

    Garden games, new smells, and friendly play matched to their energy and comfort.

  3. 1:00 PM

    Do not disturb: dreaming.

    A quiet room, a soft bed, and a proper afternoon snooze. Lunch if that’s their routine.

  4. 5:00 PM

    One more little wander.

    An easy evening walk, their familiar dinner, and a calm wind-down before tuck-in.

Their routine comes first. Timings are a sample, not a timetable to squeeze into.

05 / A LITTLE PEACE OF MIND

Before you pack
their little bag.

A few things you might be wondering. Because the more you know, the easier the goodbye feels.

Plan their first stay ↗
What should I bring?+

Their usual food in labelled portions, a lead and harness, and something that smells like home. A favourite blanket or well-loved toy can make a new bed feel wonderfully familiar. Share feeding instructions and any care needs before arrival.

What happens at mealtimes?+

Familiar food and familiar timings are the starting point. Bring their normal meals and tell the team about portions, allergies, and little rituals. Meals are served separately so dogs can eat in peace.

It’s their first stay. How do we start?+

A gentle introduction helps. Start by sharing their routine, personality, and what makes them feel safe. For a real stay, arrange a meet-and-greet with the hotel first and discuss whether a short trial visit would suit them.

What if my dog is shy or doesn’t enjoy groups?+

There’s no pressure to be the life of the party. A quiet space, slow introductions, and one-to-one company may suit them better. Tell the hotel what they enjoy and what they find difficult so a suitable care plan can be discussed.

Can two dogs stay together?+

The Snuggle Suite in this concept has room for two dogs from the same household, with a bed each. Select two dogs in the demo to see the matching room and price. The nightly suite price includes both dogs.

What about medication or special care?+

Share all care needs before arranging a stay. A real hotel would need to confirm what it can safely accommodate, any required instructions, and an emergency contact. Adding a note in this demo does not arrange or confirm care.

Does this booking make a real reservation?+

No. Pillow Paws is a hotel concept and this is an interactive booking demo. Dates, room choices, prices, and care details are illustrative. Nothing is sent, paid, or reserved. Your form entries stay on this page and clear when you reload.
